I missed this trip today. It's my fav trip of the year but life circumstances had me needing to bow out last minute. So I'm posting a photo from a former trip in nostalgia!

A long term mark and recapture study to get information about population and growth and all sorts of gooey delish data on a very special species of crayfish. 

Yes, that's a wetsuit. Yes, some caves are very cold and very wet. Yup that's a thermos too, because we want hot soup for our lunch (it's a LONG and COLD trip). 

(All research & handling done with appropriate permits, we have the training and paperwork to prove it. Please don't handle critters without it!)
